principle: Formula is a First-Class Entity (Fresco). Knowledge lives as Formula → Functional Role → Component → PSD → Functional Interface → Process → Measurements → Performance — NOT as Document → Specifications. v1.1 adds the structure that leads to BEHAVIOUR, not just the list of ingredients.

architecture_shift.note: Spec extraction stays for documents that ARE spec sheets. Knowledge Graph / Experiment / Project layers are NOT built until this schema is ratified (Fresco).

maps_to_david: Formula = Chemical System (binders) + PSD Design (psd) + Functional Premix (additives) + Manufacturing Strategy (process). Verified scope: B-4 + Dry Powder.

extensions_v1_1.1_role_as_entity: Role is a property of the FORMULA, not of the material. The SAME material (e.g. CaCO3 / Omyacarb 5) can be Packing in one formula and Opacity in another with NO change to material identity — it is not always Filler (it may be PSD controller / rheology stabilizer / cost optimizer / thermal sink / packing modifier). So FunctionalRole is a SEPARATE entity linking (formula, ingredient) → role, never a field of Ingredient.
extensions_v1_1.2_source_authority: Authority now has TWO orthogonal dimensions: FIELD (objective | interpreted | pending — is it fact, interpretation, or gap?) AND SOURCE (document | measurement | instrument | heuristic | unknown — where did it come from?). This lets future queries say 'show me only measurement-backed knowledge' or 'ignore all heuristics' without changing the object structure.
extensions_v1_1.3_functional_interface: An explicit layer BETWEEN Component and Process: how a functional role behaves and couples to process variables. Defined now (mostly pending — no process/behaviour data yet) so future linking of formulas, experiments, equipment and results needs no structural change.

invariants: field=objective ⇒ source ∈ {document, measurement, instrument} (a fact must trace to a real source, never to a heuristic)
field=pending ⇒ source = unknown (a declared gap, not a value)

field_authority._note: Default authority per field. Per-datum authority (functional_roles, functional_interfaces) is carried INSIDE each item as { field, source }.

functional_roles[].note: psd_fraction role is objective/document — the name IS a size range

boundary.identity: formula_id is PROVISIONAL until Q-009 (what change creates a new formula identity) is answered by David. Do not aggregate across formula_id as canonical yet (Law 2: Identity Before Aggregation).
boundary.role_is_formula_scoped: A FunctionalRole belongs to (formula, ingredient) — never to the material globally. The material entity carries identity only.
boundary.no_fact_from_heuristic: field=objective may not carry source=heuristic/unknown. validateFormula enforces it: interpretation cannot masquerade as fact.
boundary.pending_is_empty: functional_interfaces / process / measurements / performance are declared EMPTY (pending/unknown), not guessed.

ingredients.description: Component identity + composition only. NO role here (role is formula-scoped, see functional_roles).

functional_roles.description: Role as a SEPARATE entity: (this formula, this ingredient) → a functional role. Same material may have different roles in different formulas.

functional_interfaces.description: Explicit layer between Component and Process: a functional behaviour and the process variables it couples to. Mostly pending now.

interface.description: the functional behaviour (e.g. rheology control, packing, water demand)
